task_description: Perform a round of code quality improvements to the TV Tracker app: extract constants and utilities into dedicated modules, reduce component complexity by extracting sub-components, optimize performance hotspots, improve type safety, and fix minor code smells.

verification.summary: Build and tests cannot be run due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network (no node_modules). Code verified via semantic review and grep-based consistency checks. All imports/exports align, no dangling references, unused imports removed, type guards properly implemented. Review feedback (priority label mismatch, double loadPlatforms, ineffective useCallback, missing tests) has been addressed.
